name: How long does it take to complete interior repairs on a foreclosed property?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete interior repairs on a foreclosed property?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for interior repairs on a foreclosed property depends on the scope of work. Minor cosmetic updates, like painting and replacing flooring in a small home, might take 2-4 weeks. More extensive renovations involving kitchen and bathroom remodels, plumbing, and electrical work could extend to 2-4 months or even longer for properties with significant damage or structural issues. We work diligently to provide realistic timelines and complete projects efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair times vary based on project scope; minor updates can take 2-4 weeks, while extensive renovations might require 2-4 months or more.
